definition: S = dG_tern(NR4A3) - dG_tern(NR4A1); the binary and solvent legs cancel algebraically
sign_reading: S < 0 => the wedge is better tolerated on NR4A3 (discrimination in the designed direction); S ~ 0 => the marginal wedge is absent, which is the preregistered likely outcome and NOT a stop; S > 0 => anti-selective

system_identity_problems.why: the legs do not describe the same system/protocol

_status: DESIGN PRIORITISATION. No claim about binding, reactivity, degradation, efficacy or safety follows from S.
